name: Access Revoke — Automated (Option 2)
description: Default automated access-revoke starter. Creates an internal ticket, notifies the user and manager, and on successful notification completes the queue task and marks the certification revoked. Every step is editable on the canvas — add, remove, or re-point recipients as needed.

config.description: Fires when a reviewer signs off a revoke decision. Trigger data comes from the queue task.

config.title: Access Revoke: {{$.trigger.identityName}} — {{$.trigger.entitlementName}}
config.description: Access "{{$.trigger.entitlementName}}" on {{$.trigger.applicationName}} is being revoked for {{$.trigger.identityName}} (manager {{$.trigger.managerName}}) per certification {{$.trigger.campaignName}}. Reviewer: {{$.trigger.reviewerName}}.

config.subject: Access Revoked: {{$.trigger.entitlementName}} on {{$.trigger.applicationName}}
config.body:
Hello {{$.trigger.identityName}},

Your access "{{$.trigger.entitlementName}}" on {{$.trigger.applicationName}} is being revoked following certification {{$.trigger.campaignName}}.

Ticket: {{$.steps.createTicket.ticketId}}

If you believe this is an error, contact your manager {{$.trigger.managerName}} or the IAM team.

config.subject: Reportee Access Revoked: {{$.trigger.identityName}}

config.description: Marks the remediation queue task COMPLETED; certification is finalized as REVOKED on workflow success.

config.message: Access revoke automated for {{$.trigger.identityName}} / {{$.trigger.entitlementName}}. Ticket {{$.steps.createTicket.ticketId}}; user and manager notified.
